doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Schools attended and buying his own clothes
summary: He went to Nevins, Lafayette Junior High and Jefferson High, and by 11 was buying his own clothes with shoeshine money.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: What elementary school did you go to, do you remember that?
Nevins Elementary School and then Lafayette Junior High School.
Lafayette Junior High School and then Jeff.
Okay, so you were third in the line of the children.
So your day -- and you said you had a shoe shine -- so you’re already starting to work, you’re picking up music at eight and nine.
I was working, man. Let me tell you something, man. When I graduated from junior high school, I started buying my own clothes when I was 11 years old.
From the money you were making.
